subject: Temporary attestation request + audit window clarification for renewal
messages:
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@medlytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medlytics.com
Date: Wed, 02 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + short-term attestation for upcoming renewal

Hi Karthik,

We're in the final stages of our renewal review for the Medlytics platform integration and our internal audit needs the latest SOC 2 Type II report and confirmation on coverage for the period after the report's end date. Our renewal effective date is 2028-06-01 and procurement has a PO cutoff of 2028-05-31. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (period end and scope)?
2) If the report period doesn't cover the renewal window (June 1), can Redwood provide a temporary attestation (bridge letter) confirming controls remain in effect for the interim (through 2028-06-01)?

We attached our procurement checklist for context. Our auditors also want explicit language about key custody and log retention in the bridge wording if possible.

Thanks — appreciate a fast turnaround (we're targeting sign-off next week).

Best,
Sarah Collins
Head of Vendor Risk
Medlytics
attachments: Medlytics_Procurement_Checklist.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@medlytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 May 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + short-term attestation for upcoming renewal

Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the checklist. Looping in Naomi (Security/Compliance) and Lauren (Legal) to scope the bridge language. A couple notes up front: 

- Our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2027-04-01 to 2028-03-31 (controls tested across infrastructure, access, change management, and logging).
- We can provide a limited interim attestation (temporary bridge letter) that confirms controls remained in place following the period end and up to a specified cutover date. 

Can you confirm Medlytics' absolute procurement cutoff and whether the bridge should explicitly call out log retention and key management language? If you share the exact auditor wording that triggers acceptance on your side, we can bake it into the draft.

I'll attach the SOC2 PDF and a draft bridge template as soon as Naomi gives the OK.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@medlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + short-term attestation for upcoming renewal

Hi Sarah — quick technical note from security: 

1) Confirmation of audit period: our Type II report covers 2027-04-01 through 2028-03-31 (inclusive).

2) Temporary attestation: we can provide a bridge letter that states: 
   - Redwood Inference has no material changes to the control design or operating effectiveness since the report period end.
   - Relevant control domains remain in operation (access management, encryption at rest/in transit, logging and monitoring, incident response).
   - We will provide scoped artifacts on request (system inventory, change logs, key custody diagram, retention policy extracts).

3) Specific language candidates: if your auditor requires an explicit phrase regarding encryption key custody, we suggest the following sentence in the bridge: 
   "Redwood Inference maintains customer key custody controls via a customer-facing KMS integration; no changes to key custody responsibilities occurred since 2028-03-31."

4) Timeline: draft bridge attached (Draft_Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2028.docx). We can provide a signed PDF within 3 business days once legal approves. For DocuSign execution, we can route the final letter through your sign flow or provide our DocuSign envelope.

Attaching: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2027-2028.pdf and the draft bridge letter.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2027-2028.pdf; Draft_Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2028.docx

From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@medlytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medlytics.com
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + short-term attestation for upcoming renewal

Naomi — thanks for the quick response and the draft. A couple of clarifications from our internal audit: 

- They need the bridge to expressly state the encryption key custody model (who holds keys for customer-managed keys vs. Redwood-managed keys) and confirm there have been no changes to that model since 2028-03-31.
- Log retention: we need confirmation that auth/logging retention is at least 365 days for security-relevant events (or an explicit retention period).
- Execution: procurement prefers DocuSign if possible; PO needs to be in place by 2028-05-31 to avoid a delayed cutover.

If you can add two short sentences for key custody and retention to the bridge and confirm a signed copy by 2028-05-16, we can proceed with procurement and sign the PO.

Thanks — attached is our PO template for reference (Procurement_Standard_PO.docx).

Best,
Sarah
attachments: Procurement_Standard_PO.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@medlytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, procurement@medlytics.com
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + short-term attestation for upcoming renewal

Sarah — good news: attached is the final signed bridge letter (PDF) including the two extra sentences on key custody and log retention per your auditor's ask. Summary of what we provided: 

- SOC 2 Type II report: period 2027-04-01 to 2028-03-31 (attached).
- Bridge attestation: confirms no material changes to control design or operation since 2028-03-31; explicitly states that Redwood's KMS model differentiates customer-managed keys (customer retains custody) vs Redwood-managed keys (Redwood holds encrypted key material with HSM-backed KMS) and that there have been no changes to custody responsibilities since period end.
- Log retention: attestation confirms security-relevant logs retained for a minimum of 365 days; we can provide log retention policy extracts on request.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2027-2028.pdf; Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2028_signed.pdf; Redwood_KMS_KeyCustody_Diagram.pdf

Next steps from procurement side: 
- We can route the bridge letter via DocuSign link (https://www.docusign.com/drive/example-sign-link-7421) or accept your PO and return countersigned MSA amendment. Please confirm procurement preference by 2028-05-25 so we can keep the June 1 renewal intact.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if auditors want to walk through any of the artifacts.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
attachments: Redwood_Bridge_Letter_2028_signed.pdf; SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_2027-2028.pdf; Redwood_KMS_KeyCustody_Diagram.pdf
